'''Maryx Minor''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], covered in geysers and pits of [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. It was the location of the hermitage of the [[Ancient Order of Pessimists]], beyond the [[Maryb Wastes]]. [[Abal Karda]] fled to the hermitage with the head of [[Selestrine]] the prophet; while there, the terrified Karda threatened the hermits living there and killed one, named [[Mabob]]. Later, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] destroyed the hermitage by [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] barrage.
